# Effects of the Hidden Council. Each hides its work while the secret holds and shows one mask-safe tooltip (text secrecy rule 3).
zin_afrit_add_footholds = {
	set_temp_variable = { zin_value = zin_arg_value }
	clear_variable = zin_arg_value
	hidden_effect = {
		zin_afrit_compute_cap = yes
		add_to_variable = { zin_footholds = zin_value }
		clamp_variable = { var = zin_footholds min = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_footholds > zin_afrit_cap } }
			set_variable = { zin_footholds = zin_afrit_cap }
		}
		zin_afrit_refresh_houses = yes
	}
	custom_effect_tooltip = zin_afrit_tt_houses
}
zin_afrit_add_plot = {
	set_temp_variable = { zin_value = zin_arg_value }
	clear_variable = zin_arg_value
	hidden_effect = {
		add_to_variable = { global.zin_afrit_regicide_plot = zin_value }
		clamp_variable = { var = global.zin_afrit_regicide_plot min = 0 max = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { global.zin_afrit_regicide_plot > 99.99 }
				NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_afrit_plot_ready_seen }
			}
			set_global_flag = zin_afrit_plot_ready_seen
			Y8G = { country_event = { id = zin_afrit.14 } }
		}
	}
	custom_effect_tooltip = zin_afrit_tt_prayers
}
zin_afrit_add_veil = {
	set_temp_variable = { zin_value = zin_arg_value }
	clear_variable = zin_arg_value
	if = {
		limit = { zin_afrit_secret_kept = yes }
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { zin_value < 0 } Y8G = { has_idea = zin_worshipdom_radiant_face } }
				multiply_temp_variable = { zin_value = 0.5 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_old = global.zin_afrit_veil }
			add_to_variable = { global.zin_afrit_veil = zin_value }
			clamp_variable = { var = global.zin_afrit_veil min = 0 max = 100 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { global.zin_afrit_veil < 1 }
					NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_afrit_abandoned_aenor }
					NOT = { ROOT = { is_ai = no } }
				}
				set_variable = { global.zin_afrit_veil = 1 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_delta = global.zin_afrit_veil }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { zin_delta = zin_old }
			add_to_variable = { global.zin_afrit_veil_month = zin_delta }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { global.zin_afrit_veil < 30 }
					NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_afrit_veil_thin_seen }
				}
				set_global_flag = zin_afrit_veil_thin_seen
				Y8G = { country_event = { id = zin_afrit.41 } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { global.zin_afrit_veil < 15 }
					check_variable = { global.zin_afrit_regicide_plot > 0 }
					zin_aenor_king_alive = yes
					NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_golden_king_plot_exposed }
					NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_afrit_exposure_fired }
				}
				set_global_flag = zin_afrit_exposure_fired
				Y8G = { country_event = { id = zin_afrit.16 } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_afrit_veil < 0.01 } }
				zin_afrit_reveal = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
zin_afrit_attune_artifact = {
	set_temp_variable = { zin_artifact = zin_arg_artifact }
	clear_variable = zin_arg_artifact
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_artifact = 1 } }
			set_global_flag = zin_afrit_attuned_ring
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_artifact = 2 } }
			set_global_flag = zin_afrit_attuned_crown
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_artifact = 3 } }
			set_global_flag = zin_afrit_attuned_bracelet
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_artifact = 4 } }
			set_global_flag = zin_afrit_attuned_necklace
		}
		zin_afrit_refresh_graces = yes
	}
	custom_effect_tooltip = zin_afrit_tt_vaults

zin_afrit_compute_cap = {
	# Stores the country variable zin_afrit_cap: how deep the network can go in this country (section "Caps"). Scope: the target.
	set_temp_variable = { zin_cap_t = 3 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				tag = Y8D
				tag = Y7T
				tag = Y7U
				tag = Y10
				tag = Y0U
				tag = Y8H
				has_country_flag = zin_people_the_dead
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_cap_t = 0 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = zin_people_elves
				has_country_flag = zin_people_sun_elves
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_cap_t = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { zin_aenor_is_realm = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_cap_t = 5 }
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { Y8G = { has_country_flag = zin_worshipdom_cap4 } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_cap_t = 4 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { Y8G = { has_country_flag = zin_worshipdom_cap5 } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_cap_t = 5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = zin_region_east_lands
				Y8G = { has_country_flag = zin_worshipdom_eastern_chapter }
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { zin_cap_t = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = zin_region_east_lands
				Y8G = { has_country_flag = zin_worshipdom_eastern_reserve }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_cap_t = 5 }
		}
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = zin_cap_t max = 5 }
	}
	set_variable = { zin_afrit_cap = zin_cap_t }
}
zin_afrit_compute_watch = {
	# Sets the temporary variable zin_afrit_watch, 0 to 8: how closely this court watches the pilgrims. Scope: the target.
	set_temp_variable = { zin_afrit_watch = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_government = democratic
			NOT = { zin_afrit_is_hub = yes }
			NOT = { zin_afrit_rules_here = yes }
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_afrit_watch = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				tag = Y0M
				tag = Y0Y
			}
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_afrit_watch = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = zin_people_elves
				has_country_flag = zin_people_sun_elves
			}
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_afrit_watch = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_lost_cause_member }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_afrit_watch = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_afrit_suspicious }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_afrit_watch = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_government = neutrality }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_afrit_watch = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_footholds value = 3 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_afrit_watch = -2 }
	}
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = zin_afrit_watch min = 0 max = 8 }
}

			add_country_leader_role = { character = zin_ilvane promote_leader = yes country_leader = { ideology = zin_light_sanctuary expire = "2000.1.1.1" } }
		}
		event_target:zin_afrit_crown_realm = {
			recruit_character = zin_aurevan
			add_country_leader_role = { character = zin_aurevan promote_leader = yes country_leader = { ideology = zin_light_sanctuary expire = "2000.1.1.1" traits = { zin_trait_deliverer } } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_stance = 4 }

zin_afrit_decay_footholds = {
	# After Afrit's death three countries a month lose one foothold (deepest first, then the engine's order).
	set_temp_variable = { zin_dc_i = 0 }
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_dc_i < 3 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_dc_i = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_dc_best = 0 }
		clear_global_event_target = zin_afrit_decay_pick
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_footholds > 0 }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_afrit_decay_mark }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { zin_footholds > zin_dc_best } }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_dc_best = zin_footholds }
				save_global_event_target_as = zin_afrit_decay_pick
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_event_target = zin_afrit_decay_pick }
			event_target:zin_afrit_decay_pick = {
				set_country_flag = zin_afrit_decay_mark
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -1 }
				zin_afrit_add_footholds = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { zin_dc_i = 3 }
		}
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_afrit_decay_mark }
		clr_country_flag = zin_afrit_decay_mark
	}
}
zin_afrit_die = {
	# Afrit's death, called once by the immediate block of zin_afrit.75 (O2). The journey narrates; the Worshipdom goes quiet.
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_afrit_dead } }
			set_global_flag = zin_afrit_dead
			every_country = {
				limit = { zin_afrit_rules_here = yes }
				kill_country_leader = yes
				if = {
					limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_afrit_graces } }
					remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_afrit_graces }
				}
			}
			Y8G = {
				drop_cosmetic_tag = yes
				recruit_character = zin_ilvane
				add_country_leader_role = { character = zin_ilvane promote_leader = yes country_leader = { ideology = zin_shadow_worship expire = "2000.1.1.1" } }
				remove_ideas = { zin_worshipdom_eastern_throne zin_worshipdom_host_of_the_east zin_worshipdom_gods_court }
			}
			zin_afrit_refresh_graces = yes
			set_global_flag = zin_afrit_footholds_decay
		}
	}
	custom_effect_tooltip = zin_afrit_tt_fall
}
zin_afrit_flee_east = {
	# Afrit leaves Aenor (section "The flight east"). Scope: any.
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { zin_afrit_secret_kept = yes }
			zin_afrit_reveal = yes
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_afrit_abandoned_aenor
		every_country = {
			limit = { zin_aenor_is_realm = yes }
			country_event = { id = zin_aenor.300 }
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = { zin_afrit_rules_here = yes NOT = { zin_afrit_is_hub = yes } }
			save_global_event_target_as = zin_afrit_left_realm
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_event_target = zin_afrit_left_realm }
			event_target:zin_afrit_left_realm = {
				remove_country_leader_role = { character = zin_aurevan ideology = zin_shadow_worship }
				remove_ideas = zin_afrit_aurevan_away
			}
		}
		Y8G = {
			recruit_character = zin_aurevan
			add_country_leader_role = { character = zin_aurevan promote_leader = yes country_leader = { ideology = zin_shadow_worship expire = "2000.1.1.1" traits = { zin_trait_deliverer zin_trait_unmasked } } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_stance = 10 }
			zin_politics_set_stance = yes
			remove_ideas = zin_worshipdom_deliverers_peace
			country_event = { id = zin_afrit.53 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_game_rule = { rule = zin_rule_afrit option = HISTORICAL } }
			zin_afrit_historical_kneel = yes
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_afrit_eastern_candidate = yes
				NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_afrit_eastern_client }
			}
			zin_afrit_kneel_chance = yes
			country_event = { id = zin_afrit.51 }
		}
		Y8G = { country_event = { id = zin_afrit.9 days = 30 } }
	}
	custom_effect_tooltip = zin_afrit_tt_east
}
zin_afrit_historical_fallbacks = {
	# The established path (rule HISTORICAL, or FREE with the dates kept): the Council is ready by 15 Emberleaf 4A 1750 whatever the plot says.
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_game_rule = { rule = zin_rule_afrit option = HISTORICAL }
				AND = {
					has_game_rule = { rule = zin_rule_afrit option = DEFAULT }
					zin_rules_is_historical = yes
				}
			}
			NOT = { has_game_rule = { rule = zin_rule_golden_king_death option = NO_AI_PLOT } }
			zin_afrit_date_regicide_fallback = yes
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_afrit_regicide_ready }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_golden_king_plot_exposed }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_afrit_kingdom_behind_throne }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_golden_king_dead }
		}
		zin_afrit_ready_regicide = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_game_rule = { rule = zin_rule_afrit option = HISTORICAL }
			zin_afrit_date_flight = yes
			has_global_flag = zin_aurevan_crowned
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_afrit_abandoned_aenor }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_afrit_stand_in_parim }
			has_global_flag = zin_war_of_last_crowns
		}
		zin_afrit_flee_east = yes
	}
}
zin_afrit_historical_kneel = {
	# Under the historical rule the two AI candidates with the highest footholds kneel at once (ties: the state count, then the engine's order).
	hidden_effect = {
		set_temp_variable = { zin_kn_i = 0 }
		while_loop_effect = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_kn_i < 2 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { zin_kn_i = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_kn_best = -1 }
			clear_global_event_target = zin_afrit_kneel_pick
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					zin_afrit_eastern_candidate = yes
					is_ai = yes
					NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_afrit_eastern_client }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { zin_kn_score = zin_footholds }
				multiply_temp_variable = { zin_kn_score = 100 }
				add_to_temp_variable = { zin_kn_score = num_owned_states }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { zin_kn_score > zin_kn_best } }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_kn_best = zin_kn_score }
					save_global_event_target_as = zin_afrit_kneel_pick
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_event_target = zin_afrit_kneel_pick }
				event_target:zin_afrit_kneel_pick = { zin_afrit_kneel = yes }
			}
		}
	}
}

	# A court kneels to the King of the East. Scope: the court.

zin_afrit_kneel_chance = {
	# Sets the country variable zin_afrit_kneel_chance (5 to 95), the AI's chance to kneel at zin_afrit.51. Scope: the court.
	set_variable = { zin_afrit_kneel_chance = zin_footholds }
	multiply_variable = { zin_afrit_kneel_chance = 20 }
	add_to_variable = { zin_afrit_kneel_chance = -40 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_east_kneel_bias > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_kb = zin_east_kneel_bias }
		divide_temp_variable = { zin_kb = 2 }
		add_to_variable = { zin_afrit_kneel_chance = zin_kb }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { Y8G = { has_country_flag = zin_worshipdom_roads_east } }
		add_to_variable = { zin_afrit_kneel_chance = 20 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_government = fascism }
		add_to_variable = { zin_afrit_kneel_chance = 15 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_government = democratic }
		add_to_variable = { zin_afrit_kneel_chance = -20 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = Y14
			Y16 = { has_country_flag = zin_afrit_eastern_client }
		}
		add_to_variable = { zin_afrit_kneel_chance = -30 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = Y16
			Y14 = { has_country_flag = zin_afrit_eastern_client }
		}
		add_to_variable = { zin_afrit_kneel_chance = -30 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { Y8G = { has_country_flag = zin_worshipdom_second_embassy } }
		add_to_variable = { zin_afrit_kneel_chance = 25 }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = zin_afrit_kneel_chance min = 5 max = 95 }
}

zin_afrit_monthly = {
	# The Council's month: veil regeneration and last change, tithes, plot drift, seat drifts, graces, caps, decay after death, fallbacks.
	hidden_effect = {
		set_variable = { global.zin_afrit_veil_last_change = global.zin_afrit_veil_month }
		set_variable = { global.zin_afrit_veil_month = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { zin_afrit_secret_kept = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = global.zin_afrit_seat_censers }
			multiply_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 0.4 }
			zin_afrit_add_veil = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_completed_focus = zin_worshipdom_the_councils_verdict zin_aenor_king_alive = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_worshipdom_stay_hand } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = global.zin_afrit_seat_seals }
			multiply_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 0.5 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = zin_worshipdom_instrument_fever }
				add_to_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 0.5 }
			}
			zin_afrit_add_plot = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { zin_aenor_king_alive = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_cap_s = global.zin_afrit_seat_seals }
			multiply_temp_variable = { zin_cap_s = 10 }
			add_to_temp_variable = { zin_cap_s = 50 }
			Y0L = {
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_council_influence value = zin_cap_s compare = less_than } }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 0.25 }
					zin_aenor_add_council_influence = yes
				}
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_tithe = 0 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_footholds > 1 } NOT = { zin_aenor_is_realm = yes } NOT = { zin_afrit_is_hub = yes } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { zin_tithe = 0.25 }
		}
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = zin_tithe max = 10 }
		if = {
			limit = { Y0L = { check_variable = { var = zin_council_influence value = 60 compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { zin_tithe = 2 }
		}
		add_political_power = zin_tithe
		set_variable = { global.zin_afrit_deep_count = 0 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_footholds > 3 } }
			add_to_variable = { global.zin_afrit_deep_count = 1 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_footholds > 0 } }
			zin_afrit_compute_cap = yes
		}
		zin_afrit_refresh_graces = yes
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = zin_afrit_footholds_decay }
			zin_afrit_decay_footholds = yes
		}
		zin_afrit_historical_fallbacks = yes
		zin_afrit_ui_refresh = yes
	}
}
zin_afrit_northern_voyage = {
	# The hub sails north. The voyage takes 60 days, 30 with the maps of the cold coast.
	hidden_effect = {
		set_temp_variable = { zin_vd = 60 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = zin_worshipdom_cold_maps }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_vd = 30 }
		}
		country_event = { id = zin_afrit.32 }
		country_event = { id = zin_afrit.8 days = zin_vd }
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_afrit_rules_here = yes
				NOT = { zin_afrit_is_hub = yes }
				NOT = { Y8G = { has_country_flag = zin_worshipdom_merovan_charge } }
			}
			add_ideas = zin_afrit_aurevan_away
		}
	}
	custom_effect_tooltip = zin_afrit_tt_ships
}
zin_afrit_open_house_resolve = {
	save_global_event_target_as = zin_afrit_hub_target
	zin_afrit_compute_watch = yes
	set_temp_variable = { zin_ch = zin_afrit_watch }
	multiply_temp_variable = { zin_ch = -8 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { zin_ch = 85 }
	set_temp_variable = { zin_wh = global.zin_afrit_seat_whispers }
	multiply_temp_variable = { zin_wh = 3 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { zin_ch = zin_wh }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = zin_ch min = 10 max = 95 }
	set_temp_variable = { zin_ok = 0 }
	meta_effect = {
		text = {
			random = {
				chance = [C]
				set_temp_variable = { zin_ok = 1 }
			}
		}
		C = "[?zin_ch|0]"
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_half = zin_afrit_watch }
	divide_temp_variable = { zin_half = 2 }
	round_temp_variable = zin_half
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_ok = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 1 }
		zin_afrit_add_footholds = yes
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = zin_half }
		multiply_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -1 }
		zin_afrit_add_veil = yes
		event_target:zin_afrit_hub = { country_event = { id = zin_afrit.3 } }
	}
	else = {
		set_country_flag = { flag = zin_afrit_suspicious days = 730 }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = zin_afrit_watch }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 2 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -1 }
		zin_afrit_add_veil = yes
		event_target:zin_afrit_hub = { country_event = { id = zin_afrit.4 } }
	}
}
zin_afrit_palace_defend = {
	set_temp_variable = { zin_kind = zin_arg_kind }
	clear_variable = zin_arg_kind
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_kind = 1 } }
			add_political_power = -150
			set_global_flag = zin_afrit_def_burn
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_kind = 2 } }
			set_global_flag = zin_afrit_def_necklace
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 3 }
			zin_world_add_gathering_dark = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_kind = 3 } }
			set_global_flag = zin_afrit_def_doors
		}
	}
	custom_effect_tooltip = zin_afrit_tt_defend
}
zin_afrit_palace_roll = {
	set_temp_variable = { zin_stage = zin_arg_stage }
	clear_variable = zin_arg_stage
	hidden_effect = {
		set_temp_variable = { zin_pc = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_stage = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_pc = 60 }
			if = {
				limit = { any_country = { has_character = zin_alleria } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { zin_pc = 20 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_flag = zin_afrit_attuned_ring
					check_variable = { global.zin_afrit_seat_relics = 5 }
				}
				add_to_temp_variable = { zin_pc = -10 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_stage = 2 } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_pc = 55 }
			if = {
				limit = { Y0L = { check_variable = { zin_council_influence < 50 } } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { zin_pc = 15 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { Y8G = { has_country_flag = zin_worshipdom_oaths_renewed } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { zin_pc = -10 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_stage = 3 } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_pc = 55 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_flag = zin_glo_with_eindil }
				add_to_temp_variable = { zin_pc = 15 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_stage = 4 } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_pc = 50 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_golbran_joined }
				add_to_temp_variable = { zin_pc = 30 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_flag = zin_afrit_attuned_necklace
					check_variable = { global.zin_afrit_seat_relics = 5 }
				}
				add_to_temp_variable = { zin_pc = -10 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { Y8G = { has_country_flag = zin_worshipdom_palace_wards } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { zin_pc = -10 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { Y8G = { has_country_flag = zin_worshipdom_palace_wards_2 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { zin_pc = -5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = zin_afrit_def_burn }
			add_to_temp_variable = { zin_pc = -10 }
			clr_global_flag = zin_afrit_def_burn
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = zin_afrit_def_necklace }
			add_to_temp_variable = { zin_pc = -10 }
			clr_global_flag = zin_afrit_def_necklace
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_rel = global.zin_afrit_seat_relics }
		multiply_temp_variable = { zin_rel = -2 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_pc = zin_rel }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = zin_pc min = 5 max = 95 }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_won = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_game_rule = { rule = zin_rule_afrit option = HISTORICAL } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_won = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			meta_effect = {
				text = {
					random = {
						chance = [C]
						set_temp_variable = { zin_won = 1 }
					}
				}
				C = "[?zin_pc|0]"
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_stage = 1 } has_global_flag = zin_afrit_def_doors has_global_flag = zin_afrit_attuned_ring }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_won = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_stage = 4 } NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_golbran_joined } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_won = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = zin_golbran_dead check_variable = { zin_stage = 4 } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_won = 0 }
		}
		clr_global_flag = zin_afrit_def_doors
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_won = 0 } }
			set_global_flag = zin_afrit_palace_held
			Y8G = { country_event = { id = zin_afrit.76 } }
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { zin_stage = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_artifact = 1 }
				zin_afrit_lose_artifact = yes
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_host }
					var:global.zin_eindil_host = { country_event = { id = zin_eindil.120 } }
				}
				else = {
					random_country = {
						limit = { has_character = zin_eindil }
						country_event = { id = zin_eindil.120 }
					}
				}
				Y8G = { country_event = { id = zin_afrit.72 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { zin_stage = 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_artifact = 2 }
				zin_afrit_lose_artifact = yes
				Y8G = { country_event = { id = zin_afrit.73 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { zin_stage = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_artifact = 3 }
				zin_afrit_lose_artifact = yes
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_host }
					var:global.zin_eindil_host = { country_event = { id = zin_eindil.121 } }
				}
				else = {
					random_country = {
						limit = { has_character = zin_eindil }
						country_event = { id = zin_eindil.121 }
					}
				}
				Y8G = { country_event = { id = zin_afrit.74 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { zin_stage = 4 } }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_artifact = 4 }
				zin_afrit_lose_artifact = yes
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_host }
					var:global.zin_eindil_host = { country_event = { id = zin_eindil.123 } }
				}
				else = {
					random_country = {
						limit = { has_character = zin_eindil }
						country_event = { id = zin_eindil.123 }
					}
				}
				Y8G = { news_event = { id = zin_afrit.75 } }
			}
		}
	}
}

zin_afrit_purge_houses = {
	# Close the Houses: footholds to 0 (or down one, never below 2, if the hub has fortified them). Scope: the target.
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { Y8G = { has_country_flag = zin_worshipdom_houses_fortified } check_variable = { zin_footholds > 2 } }
			add_to_variable = { zin_footholds = -1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { Y8G = { has_country_flag = zin_worshipdom_houses_fortified } } }
			set_variable = { zin_footholds = 0 }
		}
		add_stability = -0.05
		set_country_flag = { flag = zin_afrit_houses_purged days = 365 }
		zin_afrit_refresh_houses = yes
		if = {
			limit = { zin_afrit_secret_kept = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -5 }
			zin_afrit_add_veil = yes
		}
		save_global_event_target_as = zin_afrit_hub_target
		Y8G = { country_event = { id = zin_afrit.5 } }
	}
	custom_effect_tooltip = zin_afrit_tt_closed
}
zin_afrit_raise_eastern_host = {
	# Creates zin_arg_divisions hosts of the Host of the East for the hub in the capital of the client with most states.
	set_temp_variable = { zin_divisions = zin_arg_divisions }
	clear_variable = zin_arg_divisions
	hidden_effect = {
		set_temp_variable = { zin_mx = 0 }
		clear_global_event_target = zin_afrit_host_seat
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = zin_afrit_eastern_client }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { num_owned_states > zin_mx } }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_mx = num_owned_states }
				save_global_event_target_as = zin_afrit_host_seat
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_event_target = zin_afrit_host_seat }
			event_target:zin_afrit_host_seat = {
				capital_scope = { save_event_target_as = zin_afrit_host_state }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_template = "Host of the East" } }
				division_template = {
					name = "Host of the East"
					division_names_group = ZIN_HOSTS_ZILIN_PILGRIMS
					regiments = {
						zin_men_infantry = { x = 0 y = 0 }
						zin_men_infantry = { x = 0 y = 1 }
						zin_men_infantry = { x = 0 y = 2 }
						zin_men_archers = { x = 1 y = 0 }
						zin_men_camel_riders = { x = 1 y = 1 }
					}
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_prov = event_target:zin_afrit_host_state.zin_aenor_first_province }
			meta_effect = {
				text = {
					create_unit = {
						division = "name = \"Host of the East\" division_template = \"Host of the East\" start_experience_factor = 0.4 start_equipment_factor = 1"
						owner = THIS
						prioritize_location = [P]
						allow_spawning_on_enemy_provs = no
						count = [N]
					}
				}
				P = "[?zin_prov|0]"
				N = "[?zin_divisions|0]"
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 1 }
		zin_world_add_gathering_dark = yes
	}
	custom_effect_tooltip = zin_afrit_tt_host
}

zin_afrit_refresh_graces = {
	# Each held artifact gives 50% of its graces unattuned and 100% attuned, times (0.8 + 0.05 x Relics).
	hidden_effect = {
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_afrit_graces } }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_afrit_graces }
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = { zin_afrit_rules_here = yes }
			set_variable = { zin_afrit_dm_pp = 0 }
			set_variable = { zin_afrit_dm_morale = 0 }
			set_variable = { zin_afrit_dm_capture = 0 }
			set_variable = { zin_afrit_dm_retreat = 0 }
			set_variable = { zin_afrit_dm_stab = 0 }
			set_variable = { zin_afrit_dm_ws = 0 }
			set_variable = { zin_afrit_dm_coredef = 0 }
			set_variable = { zin_afrit_dm_defstab = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_gf = global.zin_afrit_seat_relics }
			multiply_temp_variable = { zin_gf = 0.05 }
			add_to_temp_variable = { zin_gf = 0.8 }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_ga = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_afrit_lost_ring } }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_ga = 0.5 }
				if = {
					limit = { has_global_flag = zin_afrit_attuned_ring }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_ga = 1 }
				}
				multiply_temp_variable = { zin_ga = zin_gf }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_gv = zin_ga }
				multiply_temp_variable = { zin_gv = -0.3 }
				add_to_variable = { zin_afrit_dm_capture = zin_gv }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_gv = zin_ga }
				multiply_temp_variable = { zin_gv = 0.1 }
				add_to_variable = { zin_afrit_dm_retreat = zin_gv }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_ga = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_afrit_lost_crown } }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_ga = 0.5 }
				if = {
					limit = { has_global_flag = zin_afrit_attuned_crown }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_ga = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						zin_aenor_is_realm = yes
						Y8G = { has_country_flag = zin_worshipdom_oaths_renewed }
					}
					multiply_temp_variable = { zin_ga = 2 }
				}
				multiply_temp_variable = { zin_ga = zin_gf }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_gv = zin_ga }
				multiply_temp_variable = { zin_gv = 0.08 }
				add_to_variable = { zin_afrit_dm_stab = zin_gv }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_gv = zin_ga }
				multiply_temp_variable = { zin_gv = 0.05 }
				add_to_variable = { zin_afrit_dm_ws = zin_gv }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_ga = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_afrit_lost_bracelet } }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_ga = 0.5 }
				if = {
					limit = { has_global_flag = zin_afrit_attuned_bracelet }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_ga = 1 }
				}
				multiply_temp_variable = { zin_ga = zin_gf }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_gv = zin_ga }
				multiply_temp_variable = { zin_gv = 0.08 }
				add_to_variable = { zin_afrit_dm_coredef = zin_gv }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_gv = zin_ga }
				multiply_temp_variable = { zin_gv = 0.1 }
				add_to_variable = { zin_afrit_dm_defstab = zin_gv }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_ga = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_afrit_lost_necklace } }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_ga = 0.5 }
				if = {
					limit = { has_global_flag = zin_afrit_attuned_necklace }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_ga = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { zin_aenor_is_realm = yes }
					multiply_temp_variable = { zin_ga = 1.5 }
				}
				multiply_temp_variable = { zin_ga = zin_gf }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_gv = zin_ga }
				multiply_temp_variable = { zin_gv = 0.15 }
				add_to_variable = { zin_afrit_dm_pp = zin_gv }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_gv = zin_ga }
				multiply_temp_variable = { zin_gv = 0.1 }
				add_to_variable = { zin_afrit_dm_morale = zin_gv }
			}
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_afrit_graces }
			force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
		}
	}
}
zin_afrit_refresh_houses = {
	# The dynamic modifier "Houses of the First Light" follows the depth. Scope: the target.
	set_variable = { zin_afrit_dm_stab = 0 }
	set_variable = { zin_afrit_dm_pp_gain = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_footholds = 0 } }
		set_variable = { zin_afrit_dm_stab = 0 }
		set_variable = { zin_afrit_dm_pp_gain = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_footholds = 1 } }
		set_variable = { zin_afrit_dm_stab = 0.01 }
		set_variable = { zin_afrit_dm_pp_gain = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_footholds = 2 } }
		set_variable = { zin_afrit_dm_stab = 0.02 }
		set_variable = { zin_afrit_dm_pp_gain = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_footholds = 3 } }
		set_variable = { zin_afrit_dm_stab = 0.03 }
		set_variable = { zin_afrit_dm_pp_gain = -0.03 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_footholds = 4 } }
		set_variable = { zin_afrit_dm_stab = 0.04 }
		set_variable = { zin_afrit_dm_pp_gain = -0.06 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_footholds = 5 } }
		set_variable = { zin_afrit_dm_stab = 0.05 }
		set_variable = { zin_afrit_dm_pp_gain = -0.09 }
	}
	set_variable = { zin_afrit_open_cost = zin_footholds }
	multiply_variable = { zin_afrit_open_cost = 15 }
	add_to_variable = { zin_afrit_open_cost = 25 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_footholds > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_afrit_houses } } }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_afrit_houses }
		}
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_afrit_houses } }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_afrit_houses }
		}
	}
}
zin_afrit_retake_aenor = {
	# Lord of all Aoaz (zin_afrit.62): Aurevan leads Aenor again, or the hub annexes what its side holds.
	hidden_effect = {
		set_global_flag = zin_afrit_claims_aoaz
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = Y0L }
			Y8G = { white_peace = Y0L }
			Y0L = {
				recruit_character = zin_aurevan
				add_country_leader_role = { character = zin_aurevan promote_leader = yes country_leader = { ideology = zin_shadow_worship expire = "2000.1.1.1" traits = { zin_trait_deliverer zin_trait_unmasked } } }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_stance = 10 }
				zin_politics_set_stance = yes
				give_military_access = Y8G
			}
			Y8G = { give_military_access = Y0L recruit_character = zin_ilvane }
		}
		else = {
			every_state = {
				limit = { is_controlled_by = Y8G NOT = { is_owned_by = Y8G } zin_is_region_middle_lands = yes }
				transfer_state_to = Y8G
			}
		}
		zin_afrit_refresh_graces = yes
	}
	custom_effect_tooltip = zin_afrit_tt_aoaz
}
zin_afrit_return = {
	# The return from the East: the hub declares war on the controller of Parim and on the country that has Eindil.
	hidden_effect = {
		set_global_flag = zin_afrit_returned
		zin_aenor_find_parim_realm = yes
		every_state = {
			limit = { zin_is_site_parim = yes }
			controller = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { tag = Y8G }
						NOT = { is_subject_of = Y8G }
						NOT = { has_war_with = Y8G }
					}
					Y8G = { declare_war_on = { target = PREV type = annex_everything } }
				}
			}
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				has_character = zin_eindil
				NOT = { tag = Y8G }
				NOT = { has_war_with = Y8G }
			}
			Y8G = { declare_war_on = { target = PREV type = annex_everything } }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 5 }
		zin_world_add_gathering_dark = yes
	}
	custom_effect_tooltip = zin_afrit_tt_return
}
zin_afrit_reveal = {
	# The name is spoken, once. zin_arg_voluntary: 1 when the hub casts off the mask itself.
	set_temp_variable = { zin_voluntary = zin_arg_voluntary }
	clear_variable = zin_arg_voluntary
	if = {
		limit = { zin_afrit_secret_kept = yes }
		hidden_effect = {
			set_global_flag = zin_afrit_revealed
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_aurevan_crowned } }
				set_global_flag = zin_afrit_unmasked_early
			}
			Y8G = { country_event = { id = zin_afrit.42 } }
			news_event = { id = zin_afrit.43 }
			every_country = {
				limit = { zin_afrit_rules_here = yes }
				add_country_leader_trait = zin_trait_unmasked
			}
			zin_aurevan = { set_character_name = zin_name_afrit }
			Y8G = { remove_ideas = { zin_worshipdom_radiant_face zin_worshipdom_endless_regency } }
			Y8G = {
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_stance = 10 }
				zin_politics_set_stance = yes
			}
			every_country = {
				limit = { zin_afrit_rules_here = yes NOT = { zin_afrit_is_hub = yes } }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_stance = 10 }
				zin_politics_set_stance = yes
			}
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					has_government = democratic
					NOT = { zin_afrit_is_hub = yes }
					NOT = { zin_afrit_rules_here = yes }
				}
				country_event = { id = zin_afrit.45 }
			}
			every_country = {
				limit = { zin_aenor_is_realm = yes }
				country_event = { id = zin_reign.85 days = 3 }
			}
			every_country = {
				limit = { check_variable = { zin_footholds > 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = zin_footholds }
				multiply_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 5 }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_ideology = 3 }
				zin_politics_add_drift = yes
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 5 }
			zin_world_add_gathering_dark = yes
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_flag = zin_afrit_unmasked_early }
				zin_afrit_unmasked_early_effects = yes
			}
		}
	}
	custom_effect_tooltip = zin_afrit_tt_name
}
zin_afrit_spread_footholds = {
	# Raises up to zin_arg_count countries of a region (zin_arg_region, 0 = any) whose footholds are at least zin_arg_min and below zin_arg_below.
	set_temp_variable = { zin_region = zin_arg_region }
	clear_variable = zin_arg_region
	set_temp_variable = { zin_value = zin_arg_value }
	clear_variable = zin_arg_value
	set_temp_variable = { zin_count = zin_arg_count }
	clear_variable = zin_arg_count
	set_temp_variable = { zin_min = zin_arg_min }
	clear_variable = zin_arg_min
	set_temp_variable = { zin_below = zin_arg_below }
	clear_variable = zin_arg_below
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_below < 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_below = 6 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_sp_i = 0 }
		while_loop_effect = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_sp_i < zin_count } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { zin_sp_i = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_sp_best = -1 }
			clear_global_event_target = zin_afrit_spread_pick
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					zin_afrit_can_deepen_foothold = yes
					NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_afrit_spread_mark }
					check_variable = { var = zin_footholds value = zin_min compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					check_variable = { zin_footholds < zin_below }
					OR = {
						check_variable = { zin_region = 0 }
						AND = {
							check_variable = { zin_region = 1 }
							has_country_flag = zin_region_middle_lands
						}
						AND = {
							check_variable = { zin_region = 2 }
							has_country_flag = zin_region_north_lands
						}
						AND = {
							check_variable = { zin_region = 3 }
							has_country_flag = zin_region_cold_lands
						}
						AND = {
							check_variable = { zin_region = 4 }
							has_country_flag = zin_region_west_lands
						}
						AND = {
							check_variable = { zin_region = 5 }
							has_country_flag = zin_region_tritons_islands
						}
						AND = {
							check_variable = { zin_region = 6 }
							has_country_flag = zin_region_dark_lands
						}
						AND = {
							check_variable = { zin_region = 7 }
							has_country_flag = zin_region_magical_lands
						}
						AND = {
							check_variable = { zin_region = 8 }
							has_country_flag = zin_region_zols_mistake
						}
						AND = {
							check_variable = { zin_region = 9 }
							has_country_flag = zin_region_ember_lands
						}
						AND = {
							check_variable = { zin_region = 10 }
							has_country_flag = zin_region_east_lands
						}
						AND = {
							check_variable = { zin_region = 11 }
							has_country_flag = zin_region_islands_of_the_south
						}
						AND = {
							check_variable = { zin_region = 12 }
							has_country_flag = zin_region_lands_of_the_sun
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { zin_footholds > zin_sp_best } }
					set_temp_variable = { zin_sp_best = zin_footholds }
					save_global_event_target_as = zin_afrit_spread_pick
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_event_target = zin_afrit_spread_pick }
				event_target:zin_afrit_spread_pick = {
					set_country_flag = zin_afrit_spread_mark
					set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = zin_value }
					zin_afrit_add_footholds = yes
				}
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { zin_sp_i = zin_count }
			}
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = zin_afrit_spread_mark }
			clr_country_flag = zin_afrit_spread_mark
		}
	}
	custom_effect_tooltip = zin_afrit_tt_houses
}
zin_afrit_startup_values = {
	# Start values that are not per country. Scope: the hub.
	set_variable = { global.zin_afrit_veil = 80 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_afrit_veil_last_change = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_afrit_veil_month = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_afrit_regicide_plot = 20 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_afrit_artifacts = 4 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_afrit_deep_count = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_afrit_seat_seals = 3 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_afrit_seat_censers = 2 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_afrit_seat_whispers = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_afrit_seat_relics = 2 }
}
zin_afrit_unmasked_early_effects = {
	# The catastrophe the hub player plays to avoid: the name comes out before the crown is taken.
	Y8G = {
		add_ideas = zin_afrit_unmasked
		country_event = { id = zin_afrit.44 }
	}
	Y0L = {
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -40 }
		zin_aenor_add_council_influence = yes
	}
	zin_aenor_expose_plot = yes
	every_country = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_footholds > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -1 }
		zin_afrit_add_footholds = yes
		if = {
			limit = { has_government = democratic check_variable = { zin_footholds > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -1 }
			zin_afrit_add_footholds = yes
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 10 }
	zin_world_add_gathering_dark = yes
}
zin_afrit_wargoal_refuser = {
	# A war goal on the eastern refuser with the most states.
	hidden_effect = {
		set_temp_variable = { zin_mx = 0 }
		clear_global_event_target = zin_afrit_refuser
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = zin_afrit_refused_east
				NOT = { has_war_with = THIS }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { num_owned_states > zin_mx } }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_mx = num_owned_states }
				save_global_event_target_as = zin_afrit_refuser
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_event_target = zin_afrit_refuser }
			create_wargoal = { type = take_state target = event_target:zin_afrit_refuser }
		}
	}
	custom_effect_tooltip = zin_afrit_tt_refuser
}
zin_afrit_wound = {
	# Afrit is wounded at Yeldenne. zin_arg_days: how long the Deliverer rests (365 by default).
	set_temp_variable = { zin_days = zin_arg_days }
	clear_variable = zin_arg_days
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_days < 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_days = 365 }
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_afrit_wounded
		random_country = {
			limit = { zin_afrit_rules_here = yes }
			save_global_event_target_as = zin_afrit_ruled_realm
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_event_target = zin_afrit_ruled_realm }
			event_target:zin_afrit_ruled_realm = {
				add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_afrit_deliverer_rests days = zin_days }
				remove_ideas = zin_afrit_aurevan_away
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -15 }
		zin_afrit_add_veil = yes
		Y8G = { country_event = { id = zin_afrit.34 } }
	}
	custom_effect_tooltip = zin_afrit_tt_rest
}
zin_afrit_ui_refresh = {
	# Recomputes what the Hidden Council panel shows for the hub. Pure formatting: it never changes a mechanic variable.
	add_to_variable = { zin_ui_tick = 1 }
	set_variable = { zin_ui_veil_x = global.zin_afrit_veil }
	multiply_variable = { zin_ui_veil_x = 5.2 }
	add_to_variable = { zin_ui_veil_x = 27 }
	set_variable = { zin_ui_plot_x = global.zin_afrit_regicide_plot }
	multiply_variable = { zin_ui_plot_x = 5.2 }
	add_to_variable = { zin_ui_plot_x = 27 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_ui_council_open }
		set_variable = { zin_ui_h1 = 0 }
		set_variable = { zin_ui_h2 = 0 }
		set_variable = { zin_ui_h3 = 0 }
		set_variable = { zin_ui_h4 = 0 }
		set_variable = { zin_ui_h5 = 0 }
		clear_array = zin_afrit_houses_list
		set_temp_variable = { zin_nl = 0 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { check_variable = { zin_footholds > 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { zin_footholds = 1 } }
				PREV = { add_to_variable = { zin_ui_h1 = 1 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { zin_footholds = 2 } }
				PREV = { add_to_variable = { zin_ui_h2 = 1 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { zin_footholds = 3 } }
				PREV = { add_to_variable = { zin_ui_h3 = 1 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { zin_footholds = 4 } }
				PREV = { add_to_variable = { zin_ui_h4 = 1 } }
			}
			else = {
				PREV = { add_to_variable = { zin_ui_h5 = 1 } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { zin_footholds > 3 }
					check_variable = { zin_nl < 10 }
				}
				PREV = { add_to_array = { zin_afrit_houses_list = PREV } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { zin_nl = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}
